704	def _parse_sbom(sbom: object) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
705	    """Validate an SBOM document and return (identities, edges).
706	
707	    Both CycloneDX 1.5 and SPDX 2.3 JSON are accepted; the format is
708	    recognized from the document itself. identities is the set of
709	    (ecosystem, name, version) tuples registered under the importing
710	    service. edges is a set of (dependent, dependency) identity pairs.
711	    All validation happens before any database write.
712	    """
713	    if not isinstance(sbom, dict):
714	        raise ValueError("清单必须是 JSON 对象")
715	    if "spdxVersion" in sbom:
716	        return _parse_spdx(sbom)
717	    return _parse_cyclonedx(sbom)

720	def _parse_cyclonedx(sbom: dict) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
721	    """Validate a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM and return (identities, edges)."""
722	    if sbom.get("bomFormat") != "CycloneDX":
723	        raise ValueError("bomFormat 必须为 CycloneDX")
724	    if sbom.get("specVersion") != "1.5":
725	        raise ValueError("specVersion 必须为 1.5")
726	    if "components" not in sbom:
727	        raise ValueError("缺少 components 字段")
728	    components = sbom["components"]
729	    if not isinstance(components, list):
730	        raise ValueError("components 必须为数组")
731	
732	    root_ref: str | None = None
733	    metadata = sbom.get("metadata")
734	    if isinstance(metadata, dict):
735	        root_component = metadata.get("component")
736	        if isinstance(root_component, dict) and "bom-ref" in root_component:
737	            root_ref = root_component["bom-ref"]
738	            if not isinstance(root_ref, str) or not root_ref:
739	                raise ValueError("metadata.component.bom-ref 必须为非空字符串")
740	
741	    graph = _SbomGraph()
742	    for index, component in enumerate(components):
743	        if not isinstance(component, dict):
744	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 必须为对象")
745	        nested = component.get("components")
746	        if isinstance(nested, list) and nested:
747	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 存在嵌套组件，不予登记")
748	        ref = component.get("bom-ref")
749	        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
750	            raise ValueError(f"components[{index}] 的 bom-ref 必须为非空字符串")
751	        graph.ensure_unique(ref, f"bom-ref 重复: {ref}")
752	        if root_ref is not None and ref == root_ref:
753	            raise ValueError(f"bom-ref 与 metadata.component 根引用冲突: {ref}")
754	        context = f"components[{index}] (bom-ref {ref})"
755	        identity = _purl_identity(component.get("purl"), context)
756	        if "version" in component:
757	            _check_declared_version(
758	                component["version"], identity[2], f"{context} version"
759	            )
760	        graph.register(ref, identity)
761	
762	    dependencies = sbom.get("dependencies", [])
763	    if not isinstance(dependencies, list):
764	        raise ValueError("dependencies 必须为数组")
765	    for index, entry in enumerate(dependencies):
766	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
767	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}] 必须为对象")
768	        ref = entry.get("ref")
769	        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
770	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}].ref 必须为非空字符串")
771	        depends_on = entry.get("dependsOn", [])
772	        if not isinstance(depends_on, list):
773	            raise ValueError(f"dependencies[{index}].dependsOn 必须为数组")
774	        if ref == root_ref:
775	            # The list root's own outgoing edges are not registered.
776	            continue
777	        dependent = graph.identity_of(
778	            ref, f"dependencies[{index}].ref 引用未知组件: {ref}"
779	        )
780	        for target in depends_on:
781	            if not isinstance(target, str) or not target:
782	                raise ValueError(
783	                    f"dependencies[{index}].dependsOn 必须为非空字符串数组"
784	                )
785	            if target == root_ref:
786	                raise ValueError(
787	                    f"dependencies[{index}] 组件 {ref} 依赖了 metadata.component 根引用"
788	                )
789	            dependency = graph.identity_of(
790	                target, f"dependencies[{index}] 依赖引用未知组件: {target}"
791	            )
792	            graph.add_edge(dependent, dependency, (ref, target))
793	
794	    return graph.result()

797	def _spdx_purl_identity(package: dict, index: int, ref: str) -> _Identity:
798	    """Extract a component identity from a package's purl external refs."""
799	    external_refs = package.get("externalRefs")
800	    if external_refs is None:
801	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 缺少 purl 引用")
802	    if not isinstance(external_refs, list) or not external_refs:
803	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) externalRefs 必须为非空数组")
804	    identity: _Identity | None = None
805	    for ref_index, external_ref in enumerate(external_refs):
806	        if not isinstance(external_ref, dict):
807	            raise ValueError(
808	                f"packages[{index}].externalRefs[{ref_index}] 必须为对象"
809	            )
810	        if external_ref.get("referenceType") != "purl":
811	            continue
812	        candidate = _purl_identity(
813	            external_ref.get("referenceLocator"),
814	            f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref})",
815	        )
816	        if identity is None:
817	            identity = candidate
818	        elif candidate != identity:
819	            raise ValueError(
820	                f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 多个 purl 指向不同组件身份"
821	            )
822	    if identity is None:
823	        raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {ref}) 缺少 purl 引用")

827	def _parse_spdx(document: dict) -> tuple[set[_Identity], set[_Edge]]:
828	    """Validate an SPDX 2.3 JSON document and return (identities, edges)."""
829	    if document.get("spdxVersion") != "SPDX-2.3":
830	        raise ValueError("spdxVersion 必须为 SPDX-2.3")
831	    document_spdxid = document.get("SPDXID")
832	    if not isinstance(document_spdxid, str) or not document_spdxid:
833	        raise ValueError("文档 SPDXID 必须为非空字符串")
834	    if "packages" not in document:
835	        raise ValueError("缺少 packages 字段")
836	    packages = document["packages"]
837	    if not isinstance(packages, list):
838	        raise ValueError("packages 必须为数组")
839	
840	    graph = _SbomGraph()
841	    for index, package in enumerate(packages):
842	        if not isinstance(package, dict):
843	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] 必须为对象")
844	        spdxid = package.get("SPDXID")
845	        if not isinstance(spdxid, str) or not spdxid:
846	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] SPDXID 必须为非空字符串")
847	        if spdxid == document_spdxid:
848	            raise ValueError(f"packages[{index}] SPDXID 与文档标识冲突: {spdxid}")
849	        graph.ensure_unique(spdxid, f"SPDXID 重复: {spdxid}")
850	        identity = _spdx_purl_identity(package, index, spdxid)
851	        if "versionInfo" in package:
852	            _check_declared_version(
853	                package["versionInfo"],
854	                identity[2],
855	                f"packages[{index}] (SPDXID {spdxid}) versionInfo",
856	            )
857	        graph.register(spdxid, identity)
858	
859	    relationships = document.get("relationships", [])
860	    if not isinstance(relationships, list):
861	        raise ValueError("relationships 必须为数组")
862	    for index, relationship in enumerate(relationships):
863	        if not isinstance(relationship, dict):
864	            raise ValueError(f"relationships[{index}] 必须为对象")
865	        relationship_type = relationship.get("relationshipType")
866	        if relationship_type == "DEPENDS_ON":
867	            source_key, target_key = "spdxElementId", "relatedSpdxElement"
868	        elif relationship_type == "DEPENDENCY_OF":
869	            source_key, target_key = "relatedSpdxElement", "spdxElementId"
870	        else:
871	            # DESCRIBES and every other non-dependency relation are ignored;
872	            # the document itself is never a component.
873	            continue
874	        source = relationship.get(source_key)
875	        target = relationship.get(target_key)
876	        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
877	            raise ValueError(
878	                f"relationships[{index}].{source_key} 必须为非空字符串"
879	            )
880	        if not isinstance(target, str) or not target:
881	            raise ValueError(
882	                f"relationships[{index}].{target_key} 必须为非空字符串"
883	            )
884	        if source == document_spdxid or target == document_spdxid:
885	            raise ValueError(
886	                f"relationships[{index}] 引用了文档标识而非包: {source} -> {target}"
887	            )
888	        dependent = graph.identity_of(
889	            source, f"relationships[{index}] 引用未知标识: {source}"
890	        )
891	        dependency = graph.identity_of(
892	            target, f"relationships[{index}] 引用未知标识: {target}"
893	        )
894	        graph.add_edge(dependent, dependency, (source, target))
895	
896	    return graph.result()

899	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
900	# Retention rule — the single decision shared by SBOM source replacement
901	# (import_sbom) and manual-dependency revocation (remove_dependency).
902	#
903	# Both operations remove declarations and then have to decide which catalog
904	# entities actually leave. Keeping that judgment in exactly these two
905	# predicates (and reconciling through one Catalog method) means adjusting the
906	# rule once covers both operations; the decision can never drift between a
907	# re-import and a remove-dependency.
908	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
909	
910	# A relationship is retained while it keeps any basis: a manual registration
911	# OR a declaration by at least one SBOM source. Revoking the manual entry
912	# therefore leaves a source-declared relationship in place, and vice versa.
913	# Outer columns are qualified with the real table name so the same predicate is
914	# valid inside DELETE, SELECT and EXISTS scopes alike.
915	_RELATION_RETAINED_PREDICATE = (
916	    "dependencies.manual = 1 OR EXISTS ("
917	    "SELECT 1 FROM dependency_sources ds "
918	    "WHERE ds.dependency_id = dependencies.id)"
919	)
920	
921	# A component is retained while it keeps any basis: a manual registration, a
922	# declaration by at least one source, OR being an endpoint of a manually
923	# registered relationship (the anchor that keeps the two ends a surviving
924	# manual edge needs). When all three bases vanish the component is deleted.
925	# Only *manual* edges anchor endpoints: an edge a source alone declares always
926	# has both ends declared by that same source, so it never has to hold an
927	# endpoint on its own. Components are judged independently, so one endpoint
928	# leaving never blocks or cascades to the other or to anything connected to it.
929	_COMPONENT_RETAINED_PREDICATE = (
930	    "components.manual = 1 OR EXISTS ("
931	    "SELECT 1 FROM component_sources cs "
932	    "WHERE cs.component_id = components.id) "
933	    "OR EXISTS ("
934	    "SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d WHERE d.manual = 1 "
935	    "AND (d.dependent_id = components.id OR d.dependency_id = components.id))"
936	)

939	class Catalog:
940	    def __init__(self, database: str | Path = ":memory:") -> None:
941	        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(str(database))
942	        self.connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
943	        # Let concurrent writers wait for each other; guarded UPDATEs still
944	        # ensure that two processes processing one request produce at most a
945	        # single state change.
946	        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000")
947	        self.connection.executescript(SCHEMA)
948	        self._migrate()
949	
950	    def _migrate(self) -> None:
951	        """Add ownership columns to databases created by earlier releases.
952	
953	        Components and relationships already present are considered manually
954	        registered, so they survive source replacement.
955	        """
956	        component_columns = {
957	            str(row["name"])
958	            for row in self.connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(components)")
959	        }
960	        if "manual" not in component_columns:
961	            self.connection.execute(
962	                "ALTER TABLE components ADD COLUMN manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
963	            )
964	            self.connection.execute("UPDATE components SET manual = 1")
965	        dependency_columns = {
966	            str(row["name"])
967	            for row in self.connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(dependencies)")
968	        }
969	        if "manual" not in dependency_columns:
970	            self.connection.execute(
971	                "ALTER TABLE dependencies ADD COLUMN manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"
972	            )
973	            self.connection.execute("UPDATE dependencies SET manual = 1")
974	        self.connection.commit()
975	
976	    def close(self) -> None:
977	        self.connection.close()
978	
979	    @contextmanager
980	    def _write_tx(self):
981	        """A serialized write transaction.
982	
983	        ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` takes the database write lock up front, so two
984	        concurrent processes serialize their check-then-write sequences: the
985	        second blocks until the first commits and then observes its changes.
986	        Used for exemption requests and decisions to guarantee that a scope
987	        never gets two live requests and that a request changes state at most
988	        once.
989	        """
990	        self.connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
991	        try:
992	            yield
993	        except Exception:
994	            self.connection.rollback()
995	            raise

1011	    @contextmanager
1012	    def _read_snapshot(self):
1013	        """A consistent read snapshot spanning several statements.
1014	
1015	        Outside a transaction every SELECT runs in its own autocommit
1016	        read, so a report built from several queries could observe
1017	        different committed states when another process replaces a source
1018	        in between — e.g. new dependency edges over the old component
1019	        list. Bracketing the reads in one transaction pins them to a
1020	        single database state: a concurrent update is either seen whole
1021	        or not at all, never mixed into the same report.
1022	
1023	        A caller-managed transaction is left untouched: reads inside it
1024	        already see one consistent state including the caller's own
1025	        uncommitted changes, and the report must never commit or roll
1026	        back work it does not own. The transaction opened here is
1027	        read-only and always rolled back — also when a query fails (e.g.
1028	        an unparseable component version) — so the report never modifies
1029	        catalog data and the same Catalog object stays usable afterwards.
1030	        """
1031	        if self.connection.in_transaction:
1032	            yield
1033	            return
1034	        self.connection.execute("BEGIN")
1035	        try:
1036	            yield
1037	        finally:
1038	            self.connection.rollback()

1132	    def _reconcile_retention(
1133	        self,
1134	        candidate_dependency_ids: set[int] | None = None,
1135	        candidate_component_ids: set[int] | tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
1136	    ) -> tuple[int, int]:
1137	        """Apply the one retention rule after declarations were removed.
1138	
1139	        This is the only place that deletes entities for having lost every
1140	        reason to stay, so ``import_sbom`` (source replacement) and
1141	        ``remove_dependency`` (manual revocation) can never disagree:
1142	
1143	        * a relationship leaves only when it is neither manually registered
1144	          nor declared by any remaining source;
1145	        * a component leaves only when it is not manually registered, is
1146	          declared by no remaining source, and is not an endpoint of any
1147	          surviving manually registered relationship.
1148	
1149	        Relationships are reconciled first, so a relationship that loses its
1150	        last basis releases the endpoints it was anchoring. Components are
1151	        then judged independently against the surviving relationships — one
1152	        endpoint leaving never blocks or cascades to the other, or to any
1153	        connected component.
1154	
1155	        The candidate sets bound which entities may be deleted. ``None`` means
1156	        "every entity" (a source replacement can affect the whole catalog); a
1157	        targeted operation passes just the edge and the two endpoints it
1158	        touched, so revoking one relationship can never sweep unrelated
1159	        entities. The bound is only a scope: the two retention predicates are
1160	        still what decides each candidate.
1161	
1162	        Returns ``(deleted_components, deleted_dependencies)`` counting the
1163	        rows that actually left, so a source merely losing one declaration
1164	        while the entity stays (another source/manual basis remains) is never
1165	        counted as a deletion.
1166	        """
1167	        if candidate_dependency_ids is None:
1168	            dependency_scope = ""
1169	            dependency_params: tuple = ()
1170	        else:
1171	            placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in candidate_dependency_ids)
1172	            dependency_scope = f" AND id IN ({placeholders})"
1173	            dependency_params = tuple(sorted(candidate_dependency_ids))
1174	        deleted_dependency_cursor = self.connection.execute(
1175	            f"DELETE FROM dependencies "
1176	            f"WHERE NOT ({_RELATION_RETAINED_PREDICATE}){dependency_scope}",
1177	            dependency_params,
1178	        )
1179	        deleted_dependency_count = deleted_dependency_cursor.rowcount
1180	
1181	        if candidate_component_ids is None:
1182	            component_scope = ""
1183	            component_params: tuple = ()
1184	        else:
1185	            placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in candidate_component_ids)
1186	            component_scope = f" AND id IN ({placeholders})"
1187	            component_params = tuple(candidate_component_ids)
1188	        deleted_component_cursor = self.connection.execute(
1189	            f"DELETE FROM components "
1190	            f"WHERE NOT ({_COMPONENT_RETAINED_PREDICATE}){component_scope}",
1191	            component_params,
1192	        )
1193	        deleted_component_count = deleted_component_cursor.rowcount
1194	        return deleted_component_count, deleted_dependency_count

1196	    def remove_dependency(
1197	        self,
1198	        service: str,
1199	        ecosystem: str,
1200	        name: str,
1201	        version: str,
1202	        dependency_service: str,
1203	        dependency_ecosystem: str,
1204	        dependency_name: str,
1205	        dependency_version: str,
1206	    ) -> None:
1207	        dependent = tuple(value.strip() for value in (service, ecosystem, name, version))
1208	        dependency = tuple(
1209	            value.strip()
1210	            for value in (
1211	                dependency_service,
1212	                dependency_ecosystem,
1213	                dependency_name,
1214	                dependency_version,
1215	            )
1216	        )
1217	        if any(not value for value in dependent + dependency):
1218	            raise ValueError("dependency fields must not be empty")
1219	        dependent_id = self._component_id(*dependent)
1220	        dependency_id = self._component_id(*dependency)
1221	        if dependent_id is None or dependency_id is None:
1222	            # Nothing targeted: succeed without touching the catalog.
1223	            return
1224	        edge_row = self.connection.execute(
1225	            "SELECT id FROM dependencies "
1226	            "WHERE dependent_id = ? AND dependency_id = ?",
1227	            (dependent_id, dependency_id),
1228	        ).fetchone()
1229	        if edge_row is None:
1230	            # The two components exist but this relationship does not. Succeed
1231	            # without changing anything: revoking a non-existent manual
1232	            # registration must not be a way to sweep the endpoints (or any
1233	            # other component) through the cleanup rule.
1234	            return
1235	        edge_id = int(edge_row["id"])
1236	        with self.connection:
1237	            # Only revoke the manual registration; relationships still declared
1238	            # by an imported source continue to participate in impact queries.
1239	            self.connection.execute(
1240	                "UPDATE dependencies SET manual = 0 WHERE id = ?",
1241	                (edge_id,),
1242	            )
1243	            # Reapply the single retention rule, scoped to exactly this edge
1244	            # and its two endpoints: the revoked edge may leave if no source
1245	            # still declares it, and each end is then judged on its own. The
1246	            # scope guarantees one end leaving never removes the other or any
1247	            # connected component, and that unrelated entities are untouched.
1248	            self._reconcile_retention(
1249	                candidate_dependency_ids={edge_id},
1250	                candidate_component_ids={dependent_id, dependency_id},
1251	            )

1253	    def import_sbom(
1254	        self, service: str, source_name: str, sbom: object
1255	    ) -> ImportResult:
1256	        """Register the components and dependencies of an SBOM document.
1257	
1258	        Both CycloneDX 1.5 and SPDX 2.3 JSON are accepted; the format is
1259	        detected automatically.
1260	
1261	        The source (service, source_name) is replaced: its previous components
1262	        and relationships lose ownership, and components/relationships no
1263	        longer owned by any source or manually registered are deleted. The
1264	        whole list is validated before any write, so failures leave the
1265	        catalog untouched.
1266	        """
1267	        service = service.strip()
1268	        source_name = source_name.strip()
1269	        if not service or not source_name:
1270	            raise ValueError("service 和 source 名称不能为空")
1271	        identities, edges = _parse_sbom(sbom)
1272	
1273	        with self.connection:
1274	            source_row = self.connection.execute(
1275	                "SELECT id FROM sources WHERE service = ? AND name = ?",
1276	                (service, source_name),
1277	            ).fetchone()
1278	            if source_row is None:
1279	                source_id = int(
1280	                    self.connection.execute(
1281	                        "INSERT INTO sources(service, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
1282	                        (service, source_name),
1283	                    ).lastrowid
1284	                )
1285	            else:
1286	                source_id = int(source_row["id"])
1287	
1288	            # Drop the previous ownership of this source.
1289	            self.connection.execute(
1290	                "DELETE FROM component_sources WHERE source_id = ?", (source_id,)
1291	            )
1292	            self.connection.execute(
1293	                "DELETE FROM dependency_sources WHERE source_id = ?", (source_id,)
1294	            )
1295	
1296	            added_components = 0
1297	            component_ids: dict[tuple[str, str, str], int] = {}
1298	            for ecosystem, name, version in sorted(identities):
1299	                row = self.connection.execute(
1300	                    "SELECT id FROM components "
1301	                    "WHERE service = ? AND ecosystem = ? AND name = ? AND version = ?",
1302	                    (service, ecosystem, name, version),
1303	                ).fetchone()
1304	                if row is None:
1305	                    component_id = int(
1306	                        self.connection.execute(
1307	                            "INSERT INTO components(service, ecosystem, name, version, manual) "
1308	                            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)",
1309	                            (service, ecosystem, name, version),
1310	                        ).lastrowid
1311	                    )
1312	                    added_components += 1
1313	                else:
1314	                    component_id = int(row["id"])
1315	                component_ids[(ecosystem, name, version)] = component_id
1316	                self.connection.execute(
1317	                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO component_sources(component_id, source_id) "
1318	                    "VALUES (?, ?)",
1319	                    (component_id, source_id),
1320	                )
1321	
1322	            added_dependencies = 0
1323	            for dependent_identity, dependency_identity in sorted(edges):
1324	                dependent_id = component_ids[dependent_identity]
1325	                dependency_id = component_ids[dependency_identity]
1326	                row = self.connection.execute(
1327	                    "SELECT id FROM dependencies "
1328	                    "WHERE dependent_id = ? AND dependency_id = ?",
1329	                    (dependent_id, dependency_id),
1330	                ).fetchone()
1331	                if row is None:
1332	                    dependency_row_id = int(
1333	                        self.connection.execute(
1334	                            "INSERT INTO dependencies(dependent_id, dependency_id, manual) "
1335	                            "VALUES (?, ?, 0)",
1336	                            (dependent_id, dependency_id),
1337	                        ).lastrowid
1338	                    )
1339	                    added_dependencies += 1
1340	                else:
1341	                    dependency_row_id = int(row["id"])
1342	                self.connection.execute(
1343	                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dependency_sources(dependency_id, source_id) "
1344	                    "VALUES (?, ?)",
1345	                    (dependency_row_id, source_id),
1346	                )
1347	
1348	            # Reapply the single retention rule after this source's ownership
1349	            # was withdrawn and the new declaration recorded. Scope is the
1350	            # whole catalog: any relationship no longer manually registered
1351	            # and declared by no source leaves, and any component that has
1352	            # likewise lost all three bases follows (independently per
1353	            # component). The returned counts count rows that actually leave,
1354	            # so a source merely withdrawing one declaration while another
1355	            # source or a manual registration keeps the entity is not a
1356	            # deletion. remove_dependency runs the exact same rule.
1357	            deleted_components, deleted_dependencies = self._reconcile_retention()
1358	
1359	        return ImportResult(
1360	            source_components=len(identities),
1361	            added_components=added_components,
1362	            deleted_components=deleted_components,
1363	            added_dependencies=added_dependencies,
1364	            deleted_dependencies=deleted_dependencies,
1365	        )

1467	    def _direct_hits(
1468	        self, components: dict[int, dict[str, str]]
1469	    ) -> dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]]:
1470	        """Find the components directly hit by every vulnerability kind.
1471	
1472	        Returns a mapping from an impact-group key
1473	        ``(source, vulnerability id, matched package)`` — ``source`` is None
1474	        for a manually registered vulnerability and the source name for an
1475	        imported OSV record — to a mapping of directly hit component ids to
1476	        the hit description recorded at that terminal: ``severity``,
1477	        ``severity_basis`` and ``matched_conditions``.
1478	
1479	        Manual observations hit components by their verbatim package name and
1480	        carry no version conditions or severity basis. OSV records match on
1481	        the normalized PyPI package name and on the union of explicit
1482	        versions and ECOSYSTEM ranges compared with PEP 440; a candidate
1483	        component whose version cannot be parsed is a query error that
1484	        points out the component. Gathering both kinds here lets dependency
1485	        propagation, path selection and record generation share one code
1486	        path.
1487	        """
1488	        groups: dict[tuple[str | None, str, str], dict[int, dict]] = {}
1489	
1490	        for observation in self.connection.execute(
1491	            "SELECT id, component_name, severity FROM vulnerabilities"
1492	        ):
1493	            matched_name = str(observation["component_name"])
1494	            key = (None, str(observation["id"]), matched_name)
1495	            detail = {
1496	                "severity": str(observation["severity"]),
1497	                "severity_basis": None,
1498	                "matched_conditions": None,
1499	            }
1500	            terminals = groups.setdefault(key, {})
1501	            for component_id, component in components.items():
1502	                if component["name"] == matched_name:
1503	                    terminals[component_id] = detail
1504	
1505	        records = self._osv_records()
1506	        if records:
1507	            by_package: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
1508	            for record in records:
1509	                by_package.setdefault(record["package_name"], []).append(record)
1510	
1511	            for component_id, component in components.items():
1512	                if component["ecosystem"] != "pypi":
1513	                    continue
1514	                normalized = normalize_pypi_name(component["name"])
1515	                candidates = by_package.get(normalized)
1516	                if candidates is None:
1517	                    continue
1518	                try:
1519	                    version = Version(component["version"])
1520	                except InvalidVersion as error:
1521	                    raise ValueError(
1522	                        f"组件 {component['service']}/{component['ecosystem']}/"
1523	                        f"{component['name']}/{component['version']} 版本无法解析"
1524	                    ) from error
1525	                for record in candidates:
1526	                    matched_conditions = [
1527	                        _format_condition(condition)
1528	                        for condition in record["conditions"]
1529	                        if _condition_matches(condition, version)
1530	                    ]
1531	                    if matched_conditions:
1532	                        key = (record["source"], record["id"], normalized)
1533	                        groups.setdefault(key, {})[component_id] = {
1534	                            "severity": record["severity"],
1535	                            "severity_basis": (
1536	                                "default"
1537	                                if record["severity_default"]
1538	                                else "declared"
1539	                            ),
1540	                            "matched_conditions": matched_conditions,
1541	                        }
1542	        return groups

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sqlite3
from collections import deque
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from packaging.version import InvalidVersion, Version


SCHEMA = """
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS components (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    service TEXT NOT NULL,
    ecosystem TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE(service, ecosystem, name, version)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vulnerabilities (
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    component_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
    PRIMARY KEY(id, component_name)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dependencies (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dependent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    dependency_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE(dependent_id, dependency_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sources (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    service TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(service, name)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS component_sources (
    component_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY(component_id, source_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dependency_sources (
    dependency_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dependencies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY(dependency_id, source_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS osv_vulnerabilities (
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
    severity_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    withdrawn TEXT,
    conditions TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(source, id, package_name)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exemption_requests (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    service TEXT NOT NULL,
    ecosystem TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    vulnerability TEXT NOT NULL,
    matched_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    applicant TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'revoked')),
    decided_at TEXT,
    approver TEXT,
    decision_note TEXT,
    approved_severity TEXT,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exemption_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
